description:
Join me as I visit the stunning St. Martin's Island in Bangladesh, where I meet locals Aziz and Kader, who are tirelessly working to protect critically endangered sea turtles. Discover the challenges they face from noise pollution, dogs, and littering caused by tourists. 

We visit a turtle hatchery, explore a local market, and enjoy a traditional meal with Kader's family. Learn how you can help make a big difference to the future of this beautiful island. Remember to like, comment, and subscribe to support more travel vlogs and adventures!

For further information or to offer donations and support, please email Hasna Moudud at cleanwater07@gmail.com
